statusNote: Internal legal research register. Not a legal opinion, not a clearance certificate and not advice. Official primary sources are recorded with retrieval dates; 'CONSUMED_FROM_PREDECESSOR_EVIDENCE' means the predecessor milestone recorded the source and this milestone did not re-retrieve the full text. 'NOT_RETRIEVED' sources are listed honestly and cannot support a compliance conclusion. An identified obligation is not compliance.

sources.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements (Cyber Resilience Act)
provisions: Art 13 manufacturer obligations and support period
Annex III/IV important and critical products
sources.obligationSummary: Manufacturers of products with digital elements must meet essential cybersecurity requirements, handle vulnerabilities, provide security updates for a defined support period, report actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents, and complete conformity assessment with CE marking.
sources.uncertainty: Product classification (default/important/critical) and the applicable conformity route for each MAREA family are not established; the reporting duties already apply.

sources.instrument: Directive (EU) 2024/2853 on liability for defective products
provisions: Art 4 defectiveness including software and updates
Corrigendum OJ L 2026/90364 (2026-05-07) corrects Art 2(1): products placed on the market after 2026-12-08
sources.obligationSummary: Producers, importers, authorised representatives and fulfilment service providers may be liable for defective products, including software and connected products; defect and causation may be presumed in complex cases. The May 2026 corrigendum corrects the temporal scope to products placed on the market after 8 December 2026.
sources.uncertainty: The Spanish transposition instrument was NOT_RETRIEVED; its implementing rules must be confirmed by counsel before reliance.

sources.instrument: Directive 2014/53/EU on the making available on the market of radio equipment (Radio Equipment Directive)
sources.obligationSummary: Radio equipment must meet safety, EMC and spectrum essential requirements and carry CE marking after conformity assessment; radio products with digital elements also fall under the CRA from 2027-12-11.
sources.uncertainty: Which MAREA SKUs intentionally transmit or receive radio waves is not finally frozen; the module-vs-product distinction matters.

sources.instrument: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/30 supplementing Directive 2014/53/EU as regards the essential requirements for cybersecurity
provisions: Application postponed to 2025-08-01 by the 2023 amendment
Repealed with effect from 2027-12-11 by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/339
sources.obligationSummary: Delegated cybersecurity requirements applied to internet-connected radio equipment from 2025-08-01; Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/339 repeals them with effect from 2027-12-11, when the CRA takes over.
sources.uncertainty: The repeal measure and the amendment history are recorded from official sources retrieved this session; the consolidated transitional position should still be confirmed before reliance.

sources.instrument: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/339 repealing Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/30
provisions: Repeal of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/30 with effect from 2027-12-11
Recital 2 confirms that DelReg 2022/30 applied from 2025-08-01
sources.obligationSummary: Repeals the RED delegated cybersecurity regulation so that the CRA carries the cybersecurity requirements for radio equipment from 2027-12-11; the repeal takes effect on the same date.
sources.uncertainty: Transitional provisions for products placed before 2027-12-11 require counsel confirmation.

sources.instrument: Directive 2014/30/EU on the harmonisation of the laws of the Member States relating to electromagnetic compatibility
sources.obligationSummary: Apparatus must not generate excessive electromagnetic disturbance and must have adequate immunity; radio equipment covered by the RED carries its own EMC requirement instead.
sources.uncertainty: The EMC/RED boundary per SKU depends on whether the product is radio equipment.

sources.instrument: Directive 2014/35/EU on the harmonisation of the laws of the Member States relating to the making available on the market of electrical equipment designed for use within certain voltage limits (Low Voltage Directive)
provisions: Art 4 voltage scope 50-1000 V AC / 75-1500 V DC
sources.obligationSummary: Electrical equipment within the voltage limits must satisfy safety objectives; equipment outside the voltage scope or covered by other harmonised legislation may not be in scope.
sources.uncertainty: Marine 12/24 V DC products are generally outside the LVD voltage scope; applicability must be reasoned per SKU rather than assumed.

sources.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2023/988 on general product safety (General Product Safety Regulation)
sources.obligationSummary: Products must be safe; manufacturers and distributors have information, traceability, incident-reporting and corrective-action duties, and online offers must carry specified safety and traceability information.
sources.uncertainty: Interaction with product-specific harmonised legislation must be assessed per family; GPSR residual role differs where sectoral rules fully harmonise.

sources.instrument: Directive 2011/65/EU on the restriction of the use of certain hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment (RoHS)
sources.obligationSummary: Electrical and electronic equipment must not contain restricted substances above the thresholds; manufacturers must draw up technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity.
sources.uncertainty: Supplier material declarations are absent; compliance cannot be assumed from module certificates.

sources.instrument: Directive 2012/19/EU on waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE)
sources.obligationSummary: Producers of EEE must register, finance take-back and recycling, mark equipment and report; online sellers may be treated as producers.
sources.uncertainty: Spanish producer registration numbers and scheme membership do not exist.

sources.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 concerning batteries and waste batteries
sources.obligationSummary: Batteries must meet sustainability, labelling, conformity and take-back obligations; producer registration and due diligence apply where batteries are placed on the market.
sources.uncertainty: Whether MAREA devices contain batteries and which category applies (portable/LMT) is not frozen.

sources.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2025/40 on packaging and packaging waste
sources.obligationSummary: Packaging placed on the market must meet sustainability and labelling requirements, with producer-responsibility registration and reporting in each Member State.
sources.uncertainty: Packaging design and Spanish registration are not established.

sources.instrument: Directive 2013/53/EU on recreational craft and personal watercraft
sources.obligationSummary: Recreational craft and certain components must meet essential safety requirements and carry CE marking; the RCD applies to the craft or covered component, not automatically to an add-on electronics product.
sources.uncertainty: Whether any MAREA product is a 'component' within the RCD scope or an add-on outside it requires a product-specific legal analysis.

sources.instrument: Directive 2014/90/EU on marine equipment (Marine Equipment Directive)
sources.obligationSummary: Marine equipment placed on EU ships must meet MED requirements and carry the wheelmark; recreational electronics sold to leisure craft are generally outside the MED shipborne scope.
sources.uncertainty: No wheelmark may be claimed; applicability depends on whether a product is shipborne equipment under the MED, which is not established.

sources.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data (GDPR)
sources.obligationSummary: Processing requires a lawful basis, transparency, data-subject rights, processor agreements, security, breach notification and a DPIA where the processing is likely to result in high risk.
sources.uncertainty: Identifiability of vessel telemetry is context-dependent; no role map, DPIA or DPA exists.

sources.instrument: Directive 2002/58/EC concerning the processing of personal data and the protection of privacy in the electronic communications sector (ePrivacy Directive)
sources.obligationSummary: Non-essential cookies and device storage require prior informed consent, and traffic/location data require protection and transparency.
sources.uncertainty: The existing site's consent mechanism and cookie inventory are unverified.

sources.instrument: Directive 2011/83/EU on consumer rights
sources.obligationSummary: Distance contracts require precontractual information, a 14-day withdrawal right with defined exceptions, and refunds within the statutory period.
sources.uncertainty: No approved consumer terms or withdrawal flow exist.

sources.instrument: Directive (EU) 2019/771 on certain aspects concerning contracts for the sale of goods
sources.obligationSummary: Sellers must deliver goods in conformity, provide updates where required, and offer repair, replacement, price reduction or termination; Spain applies a 3-year guarantee with a 24-month presumption.
sources.uncertainty: Commercial warranty drafts do not yet preserve the statutory rights.

sources.instrument: Directive (EU) 2019/770 on certain aspects concerning contracts for the supply of digital content and digital services
sources.obligationSummary: Digital content and services must conform, be updated as required, and give rise to remedies including termination and data export; subscription terms must reflect this.
sources.uncertainty: Subscription terms, update commitments and data-export rights are absent.

sources.instrument: Directive 2005/29/EC concerning unfair business-to-consumer commercial practices
sources.obligationSummary: Commercial statements must not be misleading or omit material information; unsupported availability, certification, performance or price claims breach the UCPD.
sources.uncertainty: Existing public copy was not written under the MC-14 claims policy and requires remediation.

sources.instrument: Directive 98/6/EC on consumer protection in the indication of the prices of products offered to consumers
sources.obligationSummary: The selling price, including VAT and taxes, must be indicated clearly; any price shown must be an approved selling price, not an internal hypothesis.
sources.uncertainty: Every MAREA price is HYPOTHESIS_UNAPPROVED and no final price exists.

sources.instrument: Directive 2000/31/EC on electronic commerce
sources.obligationSummary: Information-society service providers must identify themselves, label commercial communications and provide contract information before ordering.
sources.uncertainty: The company legal identity is missing from the site.

sources.instrument: Directive (EU) 2015/2366 on payment services in the internal market (PSD2)
sources.obligationSummary: Payment-service roles and authorisation depend on the model; a hosted/tokenised merchant model reduces but does not automatically remove scope.
sources.uncertainty: No merchant agreement or provider onboarding exists; role analysis is not performed.

sources.instrument: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/389 supplementing PSD2 with regard to regulatory technical standards for strong customer authentication
sources.obligationSummary: Electronic payments must apply strong customer authentication subject to the defined exemptions; the provider's hosted flow determines implementation.
sources.uncertainty: No checkout flow or provider contract exists. Entry into force corrected to 2018-03-14 (OJ publication 2018-03-13; Art 38(1)); application remains 2019-09-14.

sources.instrument: Directive 2006/112/EC on the common system of value added tax
sources.obligationSummary: VAT applies to supplies of goods and services with place-of-supply, invoicing and rate rules; B2B reverse charge and OSS affect the displayed price and the invoice.
sources.uncertainty: Spanish 21% is verified for Spain but cross-border B2C, OSS and import VAT treatment require professional confirmation.

sources.instrument: Council Implementing Regulation (EU) No 282/2011 laying down implementing measures for Directive 2006/112/EC
sources.obligationSummary: Defines evidence and presumptions for the place of supply of digital services, relevant to OSS registration and VAT-inclusive pricing.
sources.uncertainty: OSS registration decision and evidence of customer location are not established.

sources.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2017/1001 on the European Union trade mark
sources.obligationSummary: EU trade mark rights arise only by registration; use of an unregistered proposed mark creates prior-right and opposition risk and cannot be presented as registered.
sources.uncertainty: MAREA clearance and registration are NOT_GRANTED; a prior-use signal exists.

sources.instrument: European Commission guidance on CE marking and the obligations of manufacturers
sources.obligationSummary: The manufacturer must carry out conformity assessment, draw up technical documentation and an EU declaration of conformity, and affix CE marking before placing the product on the market.
sources.uncertainty: No conformity route, DoC or test report exists for any MAREA product.

sources.instrument: Commission Notice — The Blue Guide on the implementation of EU product rules 2022 (2022/C 247/01)
sources.obligationSummary: Explains the product-rule framework, the roles of manufacturer/importer/distributor and the principle that integrating certified modules creates a new product that must be assessed.
sources.uncertainty: Interpretive guidance, not law; the specific applicable directive prevails. Verification corrected on 2026-11-02 against the research dossier: full text/page not retrievable this session, so no conclusion may rely on it.

sources.instrument: Directive 96/9/EC on the legal protection of databases
sources.obligationSummary: Substantial extraction or re-utilisation of a database may require the rights holder's authorisation; provider terms and sui generis rights must be cleared for chart/weather/tile use.
sources.uncertainty: Provider terms are the primary source; sui generis protection depends on the dataset.

sources.instrument: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2007, de 16 de noviembre, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley General para la Defensa de los Consumidores y Usuarios
sources.obligationSummary: Spanish consumer law requires precontractual information, a 3-year legal guarantee with a 24-month presumption of non-conformity, and fair terms; mandatory rights cannot be waived.
sources.uncertainty: The current consolidated text and the RDL 7/2021 amendments should be confirmed article-by-article by counsel.

sources.instrument: Ley 34/2002, de 11 de julio, de servicios de la sociedad de la información y de comercio electrónico
sources.obligationSummary: Information-society service providers must publish identity, contact and registry data, and obtain consent for cookies and unsolicited communications.
sources.uncertainty: SITE.legal identity fields are empty and cookie consent is unverified.

sources.instrument: Ley Orgánica 3/2018, de 5 de diciembre, de Protección de Datos Personales y garantía de los derechos digitales
sources.obligationSummary: Complements the GDPR in Spain, including DPO duties, digital-rights provisions, security and breach notification.
sources.uncertainty: DPO appointment and Spanish-specific duties are not implemented. Verification corrected on 2026-11-02 against the research dossier: full text/page not retrievable this session, so no conclusion may rely on it.

sources.instrument: Ley 11/2022, de 28 de junio, General de Telecomunicaciones
provisions: Spectrum titles and radio equipment use
sources.obligationSummary: Radio equipment and spectrum use are regulated; transmitting AIS is a maritime radio service requiring authorisation, while receive-only reception remains subject to radio-equipment conformity.
sources.uncertainty: AIS receive-only scope is confirmed as the programme restriction; transmission is not authorised.

sources.instrument: Real Decreto 188/2016, de 6 de mayo, por el que se aprueba el Reglamento de comercialización y puesta en servicio de equipos radioeléctricos (transposición de la Directiva 2014/53/UE)
provisions: Art 9(8): instructions and safety information at least in Spanish for the Spanish market
sources.obligationSummary: Spanish transposition of the RED; Article 9(8) requires instructions and safety information at least in Spanish when the equipment is placed on the Spanish market. This closes the MC-11 open question on the Spanish-language duty.
sources.uncertainty: The full consolidated text should still be checked by counsel for any amendment after 2016.

sources.instrument: Real Decreto 186/2016, de 6 de mayo, por el que se regula la compatibilidad electromagnética de los equipos eléctricos y electrónicos
sources.obligationSummary: Spanish EMC transposition; full text not retrieved, so Spanish procedural details are not verified.
sources.uncertainty: VERIFY_BEFORE_RELIANCE

sources.instrument: Real Decreto 187/2016, de 6 de mayo, por el que se regulan los requisitos de seguridad del material eléctrico destinado a utilizarse con determinados límites de tensión (transposición de la Directiva 2014/35/UE)
provisions: Confirmed as the LVD transposition (not the EMC one)
sources.obligationSummary: Spanish LVD transposition; applicability to low-voltage marine DC products is likely outside the voltage scope and must be assessed per product.
sources.uncertainty: Full text not re-retrieved this session; the transposition identity is confirmed.

sources.instrument: Ley 3/1991, de 10 de enero, de Competencia Desleal
sources.obligationSummary: Unfair competitive practices, including misleading and omitted information and unauthorised comparative advertising, are actionable by competitors and consumers.
sources.uncertainty: Existing public copy is not audited against this law. Verification corrected on 2026-11-02 against the research dossier: full text/page not retrievable this session, so no conclusion may rely on it.

sources.instrument: Ley 34/1988, de 11 de noviembre, General de Publicidad
sources.obligationSummary: Advertising must be truthful; misleading or unfair advertising can be stopped and corrected by the authorities and courts.
sources.uncertainty: No advertising review process exists. Verification corrected on 2026-11-02 against the research dossier: full text/page not retrievable this session, so no conclusion may rely on it.

sources.instrument: Registro de productores de productos — Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico
sources.obligationSummary: Producers of EEE, batteries and packaged goods must register in the Spanish producer register and comply with take-back and reporting duties.
sources.uncertainty: No registration exists; the applicable stream depends on the final product composition.

sources.instrument: Agencia Española de Protección de Datos — guidance on data protection impact assessments
sources.obligationSummary: AEPD guidance supports DPIA methodology; the page was inaccessible during predecessor research, so reliance is limited to the GDPR text.
sources.uncertainty: Guidance not retrieved (HTTP 404 recorded on 2026-11-02).

sources.instrument: Instituto Hidrográfico de la Marina — official nautical chart and ENC distribution
sources.obligationSummary: Official chart and ENC redistribution requires a distributor/OEM agreement and per-user licences; public access to data is not a redistribution right.
sources.uncertainty: No agreement exists; official licensing terms were not retrieved. Verification corrected on 2026-11-02 against the research dossier: full text/page not retrievable this session, so no conclusion may rely on it.

sources.instrument: Agencia Estatal de Meteorología — terms of use of meteorological data and products
sources.obligationSummary: AEMET data reuse is subject to its legal notice; numerical weather prediction outputs are not automatically open for commercial re-display.
sources.uncertainty: Terms not retrieved this session; predecessor research recorded restrictions.

sources.instrument: NMEA 2000 licensing and standards participation
sources.obligationSummary: Implementing or marketing NMEA 2000 products requires the applicable NMEA licence, membership, manufacturer/product codes and certification; read-only interoperability is not certification.
sources.uncertainty: No NMEA membership, licence or product codes exist.

sources.instrument: NMEA 0183 interface standard
sources.obligationSummary: NMEA 0183 compatibility statements require tested sentence-level interoperability; the standard itself is not a certification mark.
sources.uncertainty: No tested NMEA 0183 sentence matrix exists.

sources.instrument: NMEA product certification programme
sources.obligationSummary: NMEA certification is a voluntary product programme with its own testing and trademark rules; no MAREA product is certified.
sources.uncertainty: No certificate exists.

sources.instrument: EUIPO eSearch plus — EU trade mark database
sources.obligationSummary: Official register for EU trade mark status; absence of a registration for MAREA does not itself establish availability or non-infringement.
sources.uncertainty: No formal clearance search was commissioned in MC-14; the register is recorded as a source only. Verification corrected on 2026-11-02 against the research dossier: full text/page not retrievable this session, so no conclusion may rely on it.

sources.instrument: OEPM — Oficina Española de Patentes y Marcas, marca database
sources.obligationSummary: Official Spanish trade mark register source; no MAREA clearance search has been performed.
sources.uncertainty: Not retrieved in MC-14; commission a formal search. Verification corrected on 2026-11-02 against the research dossier: full text/page not retrievable this session, so no conclusion may rely on it.

requirements.obligation: Products with digital elements must meet the essential cybersecurity requirements (secure by design/default, protection against unauthorised access, confidentiality/integrity/availability).
requirements.uncertainty: No CRA conformity work has started.

requirements.obligation: Manufacturers must identify and document vulnerabilities and components, handle vulnerabilities and provide coordinated disclosure arrangements.
requirements.uncertainty: No vulnerability process exists.

requirements.obligation: Manufacturers must determine and publish a support period during which security updates are provided, having regard to the expected product lifetime; the statutory minimum is five years unless the product lifetime is shorter.
requirements.uncertainty: The 5-year figure is an engineering/financial assumption, not a legal guarantee; the support period must be decided and justified.

requirements.obligation: Manufacturers must report actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents to the relevant authorities and inform users, with early warning and final reporting deadlines.
requirements.uncertainty: Reporting duties apply from 2026-09-11; no process exists.

requirements.obligation: Manufacturers must complete the applicable conformity assessment, draw up the EU declaration of conformity, affix CE marking and retain documentation.
requirements.uncertainty: Product classification determines self-assessment vs notified body.

requirements.obligation: Economic operators may be liable for defective products including software; relevant evidence must be preserved and disclosed, and the corrected application and transposition dates must be respected.
requirements.uncertainty: The May 2026 corrigendum and the Spanish transposition calendar require verification.

requirements.obligation: Radio equipment must meet safety, EMC and efficient-spectrum essential requirements and, where applicable, the cybersecurity requirements in force.
requirements.uncertainty: No radio equipment assessment exists.

requirements.articleOrProvision: Art 17 and Annex III; Spanish transposition

requirements.obligation: Internet-connected radio equipment had to meet delegated cybersecurity requirements from 2025-08-01; the regime aligns with the CRA from 2027-12-11, and the current consolidated position must be confirmed before relying on either date.

requirements.uncertainty: The 2026 repeal instrument was NOT_RETRIEVED this session.
